verdict.detail: Discogs lists 4 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by The Gramophone Co. Ltd.

notes.text:
Original UK release in outside-laminated gatefold cover, including a 30x70cm folded lyrics poster insert.
'A-1U'/'B-1U' runouts.
Poly-lined standard inner sleeve with 'Patent Nos. 1125555, 1072844' and 'Made In Great Britain.'. 
First catalogue number on cover, insert and labels, 2nd (EMI international catalogue number) in parentheses on cover rear and insert.

This album was written and recorded in Montreux, Switzerland, between 6th and 21st December 1971 [...] with the Rolling Stones' mobile unit.

℗ 1972

File under POPULAR : Pop Groups
E.M.I Records (The Gramophone Company Ltd) Hayes • Middlesex • England
